title: Release documentation and verification checklist
description:
Author release verification documentation for ChugGate covering automated validation coverage and honest manual host-testing requirements (CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §30–§31).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §30 Testing subsections and §31 Release Criteria (full 'Ships when' list)
- scripts/validate.sh produced by k.1 (what is automated vs still manual)
- tests/ inventory and any host notes in README.md (read-only)
- Phase deliverables A–J for the phase summary

Create:
1) docs/verification/chuggate_release.md
- Title and purpose: release verification checklist mapped to §31
- How to run scripts/validate.sh (prereqs, expected PASS summary)
- Checklist tables grouping §31 / §30 items into:
  - Automated / CI-capable (build Release VST3+Standalone, ctest, RT-safety, zero-latency report 0, lookahead exact samples, bypass/state/multiband tests invoked by validate.sh)
  - Manual host validation required (DI alignment in Bitwig/REAPER, missing sidechain safe, stereo image, rejected-signal audition per topology, analyzer does not interrupt audio, GUI min size / HiDPI, visuals disableable, offline render, project reopen, pluginval where not in CI)
- For each manual item: pass criteria and host matrix notes (Bitwig Linux, REAPER Linux, REAPER Windows, standalone) without claiming CI coverage where none exists
- Explicit statement that no online service is required
- Links/relative paths to scripts/validate.sh and key test docs

2) docs/verification/chuggate_phase_summary.md
- Concise phase A–K deliverable summary aligned with §32 / plan skeleton
- Note that phase K delivers validation script + release docs + refined factory presets
- Point operators to chuggate_release.md for the ship checklist

Do not edit C++, CMake, scripts, or preset JSON in this task.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: chuggate_release.md documents how to run scripts/validate.sh
chuggate_release.md includes a verification checklist covering CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §31 release criteria
chuggate_release.md distinguishes automated/CI checks from manual host validation that cannot run in CI
chuggate_release.md lists host testing notes (Bitwig/REAPER/standalone) honestly as manual where applicable
chuggate_phase_summary.md summarizes phases A–K deliverables and references the release checklist
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: claim CI coverage for host-only checks that validate.sh cannot run

allowed: structure checklists as markdown tables or nested lists
map each §31 bullet to automated vs manual
summarize prior phases at a high level without re-litigating implementation detail
forbidden: invent green CI status for hosts not automated
